LinkedIn Ads

Connect professional audiences with qualified commercial conversations.

LAOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

LinkedIn Ads supports advertising to professional audiences through eligible campaigns and placements. MoreSpace can align a B2B offer with reviewed targeting, relevant creative, and a clear sales handoff, then compare acquisition activity with qualification and pipeline outcomes rather than relying on lead volume alone.

Useful outputs

  • Campaign structures with clear audience and budget ownership
  • Validated enquiry handoffs with source and campaign context
  • Qualification and pipeline reports using agreed attribution rules

Where we can apply it

  • Professional audience → reviewed offer → LinkedIn campaign → qualified enquiry.
  • Authorized lead access → field checks → CRM assignment → sales follow-up.
  • Campaign spend → opportunity records → pipeline review → B2B acquisition scorecard.
01

Use case 1

Build B2B acquisition campaigns for agreed roles, markets, and offers.

02

Use case 2

Connect eligible lead enquiries with a reviewed CRM qualification process.

03

Use case 3

Report campaign performance alongside opportunity and account outcomes.

Inputs we need

  • Ideal customer profile, professional roles, and approved markets
  • Reviewed B2B offer, creative assets, and campaign budget
  • Lead fields, consent language, and CRM qualification definitions

Delivery sequence

  • Map the offer and audience to an eligible campaign and lead journey.
  • Configure reviewed creative and test authorized lead or reporting access.
  • Launch within approved budgets and review lead relevance with sales owners.

Expert review points

  • Approve targeting, advertising claims, consent wording, and spend limits.
  • Verify API permissions and qualification outcomes before scaling lead acquisition.
